summary: The High Energy Lab is a Nomai research facility in a canyon on Ember Twin's equator. It is where the Nomai investigated the negative time discrepancy in warp travel — sending an object to arrive at its destination slightly before it departed — leading directly to the Ash Twin Project concept.

location: The High Energy Lab is a sub-location on Ember Twin within the Hourglass Twins.
The High Energy Lab is in the canyon on Ember Twin's equator.
Full facts about the High Energy Lab and its warp time experiments are recorded in hourglass_twins.json; the originating discovery of negative warp time is recorded in brittle_hollow.json.
